title: FIGARCH 長記憶模型測試：未打敗 GJR-GARCH (+8.7% worse)
description: FIGARCH(1,d,1) SPY w=2000: d=0.683 (strong long memory), but OOS QLIKE=0.8982 vs GJR=0.8264 (+8.7% worse). Long memory exists in volatility but doesn't improve 1-step forecasting. GJR leverage effect > long-memory for daily prediction. Another null result confirming GARCH ceiling.
